title: First finite root-line transport
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, a scheme isomorphism g:X→Y and n≥0. Use the root and finite coefficient constructions of [def-pur-twist-sheaves, def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data, def-pur-finite-tate-site-comparison, lem-pur-roots-of-unity-inverse-image-iso]. Let r be limit.post followed by the limit of the prescribed finite root maps. There exists e:F_g A_(E,n+1)(1)_Y≅A_(E,n+1)(1)_X. For every V, constant coefficient a and root-limit section x, e(eta(finiteTateProGenerator_Y(a,x)))=finiteTateProGenerator_X(a,r(eta(x))). Only the first line is compared; there are no higher powers, signed powers, uniqueness, or invertibility-of-l hypotheses.

proof.text: Apply the completed first-line transport, then the canonical scalar-extension comparison for the quotient O_E→A_(E,n+1). The finite coefficient comparison fixes constant sections, so the two sheafification units send a tensor (1 tensor x) to the displayed generator. Compatibility of the coefficient projection with pullback gives a well-defined finite-linear map. Apply the inverse constructions to obtain the inverse; tensor generation identifies both composites with the identity.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including Scheme.inv_app and stalk isomorphism lemmas; none states the root-limit coefficient comparison. A second query on maps from sheafified tensor powers returns SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections and sheafification maps, which do not establish generation by these root tensors.

TensorProduct.ext in Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Basic supplies ordinary tensor extensionality. It does not state sheafified root-power generation or normalized inverse-image maps. Earlier SheafOfModules, _ ≅ _ query returned general module isomorphisms only.

theorem frobeniusFiniteRootTransport
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g] (n : ℕ)
    (r : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
      (purTwistZlOne Y l) ⟶ purTwistZlOne X l)
    (hr : r = limit.post (proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower Y l Fact.out)
        (proEtaleSheafInverseImage g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ≫
      lim.map (((proEtaleRootsOfUnityInverseImageIso g).2.1 l Fact.out).choose)) :
    ∃ e : (proEtaleRingModulePullback g (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n)
        (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n) ((PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1)
          (Nat.succ_pos n)).pull g)).obj (purTwistFiniteOne Y l E n) ≅ (purTwistFiniteOne X l E n),
      ∀ (V : Y.ProEt) (a : finiteTateCoefficient l E n)
        (x : (purTwistZlOne Y l).obj.obj (op V)),
        e.hom.val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))
          (((proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction g (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n)
            (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n) ((PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1)
              (Nat.succ_pos n)).pull g)).unit.app (purTwistFiniteOne Y l E n)).val.app (op V)
            (finiteTateProGenerator l E n Y (op V) a x)) =
      finiteTateProGenerator l E n X (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V)) a
        (r.hom.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))
          (((proEtaleSheafAdjunction g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).unit.app
            (purTwistZlOne Y l)).hom.app (op V) x))
